question:
Which Padma awardees and fields is/are correctly paired?

1. Gokul Chandra Das – Folk Music

2. Dinesh Saini – Environment

3. Farooq Ahmad Mir – Literature

4. Geeta Devi – Agriculture
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: Gokul Chandra Das – Folk Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gokul Chandra Das** is a renowned artist in the field of Folk Music, recognized for his significant contributions to preserving and promoting traditional folk music in India.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri for his outstanding contribution to Folk Music, a category under Arts.
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, given in various fields such as art, literature, social work, and public affairs.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, conferred to individuals for distinguished contributions in various fields.
 
• The recognition of individuals like Gokul Chandra Das highlights the importance of preserving and celebrating India’s rich cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dinesh Saini – Environment**

 
 
• Dinesh Saini is not listed among the Padma awardees under the category of Environment.
 
• The Environment category in Padma Awards recognizes individuals for their work in environmental conservation, climate change mitigation, and ecological preservation.
 
 
 
• **Farooq Ahmad Mir – Literature**
 
 
• Farooq Ahmad Mir is not associated with receiving the Padma Award in the field of Literature.
 
• The Literature category in Padma Awards celebrates contributions to Indian literature, creative writing, and linguistic studies.
 
 
 
• **Geeta Devi – Agriculture**
 
 
• Geeta Devi is not listed among Padma awardees in the field of Agriculture.
 
• Agriculture-related Padma Awards are given to individuals who have contributed to advancements in farming techniques, sustainable agriculture, and rural development.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards Overview**
 
 
• The Padma Awards are classified into three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri, in decreasing order of prestige.
 
• These awards are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day in India.
 
• Fields covered include art, literature, science, sports, social work, public affairs, and more.
 
• The awards aim to recognize individuals from diverse backgrounds who have made exceptional contributions to society.
